module_summary: Video-to-memory DMA: an AXI-stream pixel FIFO is drained by an AXI4 burst writer whose frame/line address generator and run/stop controller are configured through AXI-lite registers.

anchors.name: r_stopped
anchors.why: Run/stop state: resyncs on frame VLAST, stops when idle after soft reset; gates config and counters.

anchors.name: soft_reset
anchors.why: Halt request set on bus error or deactivation; drives r_stopped transition and blocks bursts.

anchors.name: r_err
anchors.why: Sticky bus/overflow error bit reported in status word, blocks restart.

anchors.name: lost_sync
anchors.why: Set on HLAST/VLAST mismatch at write; resets FIFO and stops bursts.

anchors.name: cfg_active
anchors.why: Software active bit; cleared on error or frame count done; enables capture.

anchors.name: cfg_frame_addr
anchors.why: Programmed frame buffer base address loaded into request address.

anchors.name: cfg_frame_lines
anchors.why: Programmed lines per frame reloading line counters.

anchors.name: cfg_line_words
anchors.why: Programmed words per line reloading line word counters.

anchors.name: cfg_line_step
anchors.why: Line stride added to line address at each line end.

anchors.name: cfg_continuous
anchors.why: Continuous-capture mode when frame count written is zero.

anchors.name: cfg_zero_length
anchors.why: Flags zero-size frame config, prevents activation.

anchors.name: req_nframes
anchors.why: Remaining frames to capture, decremented at frame end.

anchors.name: axil_write_ready
anchors.why: AXI-lite write strobe when address and data skid outputs valid; writes config registers.

anchors.name: awskd_addr
anchors.why: Skid-buffered register write address selecting control/frameinfo/address register.

anchors.name: arskd_addr
anchors.why: Read register address selecting readback word.

anchors.name: S_AXIL_WDATA
anchors.why: AXI-lite register write data into write skid buffer.

anchors.name: S_AXIL_RDATA
anchors.why: AXI-lite register readback data from axil_read_data.

anchors.name: S_AXIL_RVALID
anchors.why: AXI-lite read response valid.

anchors.name: S_AXIL_BVALID
anchors.why: AXI-lite write response valid.

anchors.name: w_status_word
anchors.why: Status word with busy, error, lost sync, frame count, line step.

anchors.name: S_AXIS_TVALID
anchors.why: Incoming pixel stream valid; writes FIFO and triggers frame sync.

anchors.name: S_AXIS_TDATA
anchors.why: Incoming pixel data written into the FIFO.

anchors.name: S_AXIS_VLAST
anchors.why: End-of-frame marker used to synchronize start and stored with FIFO data.

anchors.name: write_to_fifo
anchors.why: FIFO write enable from stream valid unless lost sync or full; updates availability count.

anchors.name: read_from_fifo
anchors.why: FIFO read on each accepted AXI write beat.

anchors.name: fifo_data_available
anchors.why: Words in FIFO not yet claimed by a burst; gates start_burst.

anchors.name: fifo_bursts_available
anchors.why: At least one full burst available in FIFO; allows burst start.

anchors.name: start_burst
anchors.why: Decides issuing a new AXI burst from FIFO level, channel stall, and run state.

anchors.name: phantom_start
anchors.why: Delayed burst-start strobe advancing request address, line and frame counters.

anchors.name: req_addr
anchors.why: Next burst address in frame buffer, stepping by burst or line stride.

anchors.name: req_line_addr
anchors.why: Start address of current line for stride computation.

anchors.name: req_line_words
anchors.why: Words remaining in current line request; sizes AWLEN.

anchors.name: req_nlines
anchors.why: Lines remaining in frame for request side.

anchors.name: req_hlast
anchors.why: Current burst ends the line; selects line-step address update.

anchors.name: req_vlast
anchors.why: Current line is last of frame; reloads frame base address.

anchors.name: req_needs_alignment
anchors.why: Burst must stop at 4KB/burst boundary; selects till_boundary length.

anchors.name: req_multiple_bursts
anchors.why: Line needs more than one max burst; selects full-length AWLEN.

anchors.name: next_awlen
anchors.why: Computed burst length loaded into AWLEN and beat counter.

anchors.name: aw_bursts_outstanding
anchors.why: Bursts issued awaiting B response; overflow blocks start_burst.

anchors.name: wr_pending
anchors.why: Beats remaining in current write burst; generates WLAST.

anchors.name: wr_line_beats
anchors.why: Write-side beats remaining in line for sync checking.

anchors.name: wr_lines
anchors.why: Write-side lines remaining in frame for sync checking.

anchors.name: wr_hlast
anchors.why: Expected end of line on write side, compared with FIFO hlast for lost sync.

anchors.name: M_AXI_AWVALID
anchors.why: AXI write address valid for each burst.

anchors.name: M_AXI_AWREADY
anchors.why: AXI address ready; stalls next burst start.

anchors.name: M_AXI_AWADDR
anchors.why: Burst address output latched from req_addr.

anchors.name: M_AXI_AWLEN
anchors.why: Burst length output; also decrements FIFO availability.

anchors.name: M_AXI_WVALID
anchors.why: AXI write data valid; beats pop FIFO.

anchors.name: M_AXI_WREADY
anchors.why: AXI write data ready; advances FIFO reads and beat counters.

anchors.name: M_AXI_WDATA
anchors.why: Pixel write data driven from FIFO output.

anchors.name: M_AXI_WLAST
anchors.why: Last beat of write burst.

anchors.name: M_AXI_BVALID
anchors.why: Write response; decrements outstanding bursts and flags errors.

groups.name: Run/stop controller
groups.description: Starts on frame boundary, halts on error, deactivation or lost sync once bus idle.

groups.name: AXI-lite register bank
groups.description: Skid-buffered AXI-lite access to control, frame size and frame address registers.

groups.name: Pixel FIFO
groups.description: Buffers stream pixels with hlast/vlast tags; tracks words available for bursts.

groups.name: Frame address generator
groups.description: Steps burst address through lines and frames with stride and boundary alignment.

groups.name: AXI burst writer
groups.description: Issues AW bursts and streams FIFO data with WLAST; counts outstanding responses.

groups.name: Write sync checker
groups.description: Counts written beats and lines to detect mismatch with stream markers.
